svg.title: Hierarchical generation pipeline
svg.desc: Tier 1 (S1-S3) initializes the multi-agent world from a scenario seed and conflict/challenge plugins. Tier 2 decides every 3-4 rounds whether to expand phase milestones (S4), then synthesizes each round through eight verified sub-steps (S5.1-S5.8) and loops while r < R. Tier 3 (S6-S8) audits, refines visuals, renders and gates the verified scenario.json. Green check tags are deterministic code checks; red retry tags are bounded retries.

text.tspan: Outline next 3–4 rounds from rolling history (1 call / phase)
